description_en: List all automatic snapshot policies that you created in a region and that match your query conditions
description_zh: 查询您在某个地域下，所有已创建的符合查询条件的自动快照策略
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs list-auto-snapshot-policies --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --filter-key PolicyName --filter-value policyTest --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAutoSnapshotPolicies

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. To view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions, call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number for paged queries. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paged queries. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页条数。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The filter key to use when querying resources.

Use with FilterValue. Valid values: PolicyId or PolicyName.

If you specify PolicyId, the system filters by automatic snapshot policy ID. If you specify PolicyName, the system filters by automatic snapshot policy name
parameters.help_zh:
查询资源时的筛选键。

与FilterValue配合使用，取值必须为PolicyId或PolicyName。

传入PolicyId则根据自动快照策略ID进行筛选，传入PolicyName则根据自动快照策略名称进行筛选
parameters.name: filter_key

parameters.help_en:
The filter value to use when querying automatic snapshot policies.

Use with FilterKey
parameters.help_zh:
查询自动快照策略时的筛选值。

与FilterKey配合使用
parameters.name: filter_value
